decisions.reason: Changing the date display format does not alter the date field's help text, label language, label relationship, or hover behavior.
The date format decision does not change whether placeholder text clears when a field is activated.
The checklist control type is independent of the date selector's display format.
The source changes date formatting and does not change the separate dropdown control or its document scope.
Date value formatting does not affect the requirement to preserve title-field formatting.
The date display format does not change the visible placeholder mechanism used to identify fillable fields.
The choice of day/month/year does not change the mechanism used for ordinary text placeholders.
The date display format is independent of Enter-key and multiline text-entry behavior.
The source does not change the requested walkthrough or explanation of Master template tables.
Date formatting has no necessary effect on the approved theme-color choices.
The day/month/year date format does not change automatic bullet continuation when Enter is pressed.
Changing the date display format does not alter alignment among the Board Meeting fields.
